exact_statement: For every infinite finitely generated group Gamma and every fixed finite symmetric generating set S, Bernoulli bond percolation on Cay(Gamma,S) satisfies p_c<p_u if and only if Gamma is nonamenable.

thresholds.p_c: infimum of parameters with an infinite cluster almost surely
thresholds.p_u: infimum of parameters with exactly one infinite cluster almost surely
